articles.summary: PORT ANGELES, Wash., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Northwest Bancorp (Nasdaq: FNWB) ("First Northwest" or the "Company"), the holding company for First Fed Bank ("First Fed" or the "Bank"), today reported its financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported a net loss of $743,000 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to net income of $308,000 for the second quarter of 2026 and net income of $802,000 for the third quarter of 2025. Basic and diluted loss per share were $0.08 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to basic and diluted income per share of $0.03 for the second quarter of 2026 and basic and diluted income per share of $0.09 for the third quarter of 2025.
